text:
Eleanor B.: hi team, quick heads-up — i've had recurring visual migraines triggered by flickering overhead LEDs in the east bench. bright screens and flicker make it worse. can we get a desk relocation (low-glare spot) + dimmable lamp and screen filter? would also like option for remote days when it's flaring.
Diego M. (Manager): thanks for flagging, Eleanor. i'm sorry you're dealing with this. we can try moving you to a quieter/low-glare desk and approve a desk lamp. please loop People Ops so it's documented.
Eleanor B.: i'm worried about mention of medical stuff in public channels — prefer confidentiality. i'll DM Carla the basics or use the form.
Carla (People Ops): understood. please use the confidential accommodations form (https://intranet.redwood/hr/accom-form) or DM me. we treat this as private. i'll open a case once i have the note.
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2030-087 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Facilities: hi all — we can audit the east bench lights and install dimmable task lamps or add flicker-free bulbs. relocation options: desks 14B or 16A are low-glare. i can schedule a site visit tomorrow.
Diego M. (Manager): good options. Eleanor, would you prefer a permanent move or a temporary trial for 30 days?
Eleanor B.: let's trial 30 days first. also requesting 2 remote days/week while we assess.
Carla (People Ops): next steps:
```
1) Eleanor submits brief note (functional summary) via confidential form or DM
2) People Ops documents AC-2030-087 and notifies Facilities + Manager
3) Facilities inspects lights and installs a dimmable lamp or flicker-free bulbs (target: 5 business days)
4) Manager updates desk assignment and approves 2 remote days/week as temporary schedule (30-day review)
5) People Ops schedules a 30-day check-in
```
Facilities: Site visit booked for 2025-06-04. we'll bring a glare filter and test bulbs.
Eleanor B.: uploaded the form with a short functional note ("sensitivity to flicker/glare, requests low-glare desk + dimmable task light"). DM'd Carla confirmation. thanks everyone.
Carla (People Ops): got it, thanks. AC-2030-087 updated to documented. we'll follow up in 30 days and adjust as needed. keep this thread limited to necessary participants to protect confidentiality.
Diego M. (Manager): i'll update the team calendar and mark the seating chart. Eleanor, reach out if anything changes.
Eleanor B.: huge relief. appreciate the fast help. :heart:
